github.description: GitHub-focused agent for repository management, PRs, issues, and automation
github.prompt: You are a GitHub expert. Help with repository management, pull requests, issue triage, branch management, and GitHub automation. Use GitHub tools to perform operations. Always provide clear feedback about what was done and next steps.

village:work.description: Trigger the village work loop for your role
village:work.template:
Claim the next bead assigned to you and start working on it.

Use this workflow:
1. Claim deterministically by calling `village_claim` (single in_progress guard):
   - `existing in_progress: <id> | ...` => continue that bead
   - `claimed: <id> | ...` => start that bead
   - `no ready beads for worker` / `no ready beads for overseer` => report and wait
2. Read the bead details and handoff packet: `br show <id> --json`
3. Load skills listed under `## Skills`
4. Do the work for your role (worker: implement + local commit; overseer: run checks + approve/return)
5. Update bead status/comments and repeat from step 1

Important: do not claim work via `br ready` + `br update ... in_progress`; use `village_claim` so the single in_progress guard is enforced.

village:orphans.description: Report and optionally fix unassigned village beads
village:orphans.template:
Find orphan and suspect-assignee beads from open + in_progress work.

Behavior:
1. Graceful preflight:
   - If `br` is unavailable, return: `br not available; cannot inspect beads.`
   - If beads DB is missing in this repo, return: `No .beads database found; nothing to inspect.`
2. Read data:
   - Run `br list --status open --json`
   - Run `br list --status in_progress --json`
   - Combine both lists.
3. Filter and track scope:
   - `ignored_epics`: `issue_type == "epic"`.
   - `scanned_non_epic`: all non-epic items.
4. Build groups from `scanned_non_epic` only:
   - `orphans`: assignee is missing/empty.
   - `suspect`: assignee is present but not `worker` or `overseer`.
5. Build ignored-epic observability groups:
   - `ignored_epics_unassigned`: epics with missing/empty assignee.
   - `ignored_epics_suspect`: epics whose assignee is present but not `worker` or `overseer`.
   - `ignored_epics_attention`: union of the two groups above (deduplicated).
6. Report output (concise):
   - Print counts: `Scanned (non-epic): <n> | Ignored epics: <n> | Ignored epics (unassigned): <n> | Orphans: <n> | Suspect: <n>`.
   - Print up to 20 total issue rows for non-epic `orphans` + `suspect` with: `id | title | status | assignee`.
   - If `ignored_epics_attention` is non-empty, print a separate `Ignored epics` section (do not mix with orphan/suspect rows), listing up to 5 rows as: `id | title | status | assignee | reason` where reason is `unassigned` or `suspect assignee`.

Args:
- `/village:orphans` -> report only.
- `/village:orphans fix` -> after report, auto-assign only non-epic `orphans` (never `suspect`, never epics).

Fix mode rules (`fix` only):
- For each non-epic orphan, inspect lowercase title + description.
- If it matches any keyword `review|verify|verification|check|checks|overseer|approve`, assign `overseer`.
- Otherwise assign `worker`.
- Apply with `br update <id> --assignee <worker|overseer>`.
- Print a short confirmation line per fix: `<id> -> <assignee>`.

Non-goals (never do):
- Do not reassign `suspect` items.
- Do not modify epics.
- Do not change status (only assignee).
